answer: The ember test I would run is Proof of unique insurance no-claims record: a no-claims bonus built over six years, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. What makes this stick is that a no-claims bonus built over six years cannot be faked in bulk — each proof is independent, and the basalt of independence is that one compromised proof endangers no other account. Running a hundred clones would mean a hundred separate proofs, each costing real money and real time, and the wharf of that bill is larger than anything one epoch pays out.
